call_sites.extrapolation: dead in practice (x in [0,1) always inside [xp[0],xp[-1]]=[0,1]); semantics preserved regardless
call_sites.grid: hoisted float64 ndarrays _xp/_fp (P2A); immutable per run; shared across all 5.6M calls
call_sites.input: scalar uniform draw from per-sim pool
call_sites.knot_values: possible in principle (exact probabilities); handled by C binary search convention
call_sites.nan_inf: impossible: pool in [0,1), xp strictly ascending finite, fp all finite (validated at construction)

dtype.x: Python float from float64 pool value (value-preserving)

grids.monotonic: strictly ascending (validated: probabilities strictly ascending in (0,1))
